What the defect does: The explicit total-token field is looked up but then unconditionally discarded and replaced by input+output, so payloads that only carry a provider-reported total (with input/output fields absent or zero) end up with total_tokens forced to 0 instead of the reported value.
On this input the two differ: {'value': {'totalTokenCount': True}}
The original gives UsageStats(input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, total_tokens=1); the defect gives UsageStats(input_tokens=0, output_tokens=0, total_tokens=0).

import pytest

from llm_router import UsageStats
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.usage import normalize_usage

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_USAGE_NORMALIZATION[revision==1]")
def test_total_only_usage_payload_preserves_reported_total() -> None:
